deployment_note: shrink-to-pop is the deployed rule; shrink-to-zero is the NO_A0-consistent alternative and is strictly worse in operator units on this cohort

shrink_to_pop_split.note: row 3 total = active shrinkage + abstention fallback cost; the abstained minority dominates the pooled mean

slope_provenance: wrong-donor harm (V44-S1) over the mean RMS wrong-vs-gated operator displacement; LINEAR form mandated by the P7 dose-response measurement
slope_units: RRMSE per unit RMS operator displacement
